artifact.title: Hiring trends in India

cd8fff72-2e37-5029-b1df-0d1dc586e4ac.content_text: A qualitative look at recruiting in 2026. Employers describe hiring as slower and more deliberate than before. Many report investing in structured interviews. Remote work remains common in technology roles.
